contexts.text: Humours which in themselves are excrementitious, as are many of the salivary ones (are of use).
(The food) softened by the purer saliva alone.
(The evils and phantasies of man) imitate the circle made by the salivary water in digestion...
As is known from the salivary menstrua.
On those who relate to the salivas of the mouth... They serve to instruct others, as the saliva does to digest the things received into the mouth.
Some (of the excretions) serve for uses, as the salivas.
(Conversation at meals) opens the salivary ducts...
